description: §22.4.1 / §22.12 (PA-ruled S459: meta descriptive attrs; http-equiv refused) — `http-equiv` is refused outright in compile-time `emit()` output: `http-equiv="refresh"` with `content="0;url=…"` is a navigation sink (S456 meta refresh). E-META-EVAL-002.
rationale: §22.12 *Attributes — a CLOSED list*: `http-equiv` is on no list; §22.4.1: a name not on the list is `E-META-EVAL-002`.
